notes.title: Project Proxima v1.03 Terminal Update
notes.content:
- Added computer terminal
Use this new terminal to learn more about your ship and the mission you're on. Player can also add fuel to make their ship temporarily move faster by playing a mini game on this terminal.

- Save game feature has been fixed
- Blackhole can now kill player
- Added mouse sensitivity option (for Steam Deck)
- Planets can be seen when you exit ship
- Final Message disk is now marked on map
- Added more sound effects
- Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Project Proxima v1.01 Update
notes.content:
Just a quick fix for some bugs and better visibility for tasks

- Coordinates are now shown in player HUD
- Map grid is darker for better visibility
- Changed lighting outside of ship to show what to repair
- Monster glitch was removed from under the ship
- "Damaged Hull" text was changed to "Ship Damaged"
- Removed map numbers in control panel area
